clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the hills west of Lordaeron's ruined palace, the Sewers offer a second way into the Undercity. Their stone passage carries bat handlers and travelers past the elevators descending from the throne room.

The Sewers once drained Lordaeron's royal capital. Now Sylvanas Windrunner's Forsaken fold those old stone channels into the Undercity's defenses. The passage opens west of the surface ruins, near a Scarlet Watchtower in Tirisfal Glades, then slopes directly inside. Forsaken bat handlers fly riders through the cavernous conduit into the Undercity's subterranean rings, avoiding the slow cage lifts. The route also skirts the fortified courtyards, leaving a dangerous weakness that hostile infiltrators seek to exploit.
